commits.doc: Bay 1 cleared for the layout trial. Old racking out, floor patched and marked. Nothing on it yet.
First stations in. The knot and the two plants stand in for the mixer and the two carts. Cart paths still crossed near the door; two stoppages came from that.

Approved as the standard. Fan and lamp added so both stations have air and light; the case holds the changeover kit. Paths no longer cross. Changeover under 35 minutes for the first time, which is what we were after.
commits.by: Approved by M. Reyes, plant manager · 7 Jul 2026

0-1.doc: Stations placed for the first time. This is the layout we started the trial with, before anyone had run a shift on it.

1-2.doc: Monstera and fan moved to open the cart path; lamp and case added. Done over the weekend shutdown so nothing was lost on the line.

2-3.doc: Monstera and fan pushed toward the door during the night shift of 28 Jul to clear space for a pallet drop. Tall plant, small plant and the case left Bay 1 the same night and were not returned.
